hero.subtitle: Help us provide hope, encouragement and healing to adoptive families across California.

whyJoin.heading: Why Work With Us?
whyJoin.introAfter: , we're more than just a team. We're a community of passionate individuals dedicated to supporting adoptive families through a love-based methodology.
whyJoin.meaningfulDesc: Make a real difference in the lives of adoptive families.
whyJoin.growthDesc: Continuous training in trauma-informed care and child behavior.

clinical.heading: Clinical Roles
clinical.subtitle: Our clinical team provides the direct support and education that families need to thrive.

wrapFacilitator.title: Wrap Facilitator
wrapFacilitator.description: Coordinates the wraparound process, facilitating team meetings and ensuring the family's voice and choice are at the center of the plan. They act as the primary point of contact and guide for the family's journey.

clinician.title: Clinician
clinician.description: Provides specialized trauma-informed therapeutic support and behavioral interventions for children and families. They work under direct clinical supervision to implement love-based healing strategies.

parentPartner.title: Parent Partner
parentPartner.description: A person with lived experience in the child welfare or adoption system who provides peer support and advocacy for parents. They offer unique empathy and guidance based on their own journey.

administrative.heading: Administrative Roles
administrative.subtitle: Our administrative team ensures that our operations run smoothly, allowing our clinical staff to focus entirely on the families we serve.
administrative.operationsDesc: Includes roles in Human Resources, Finance, Office Management, and Program Coordination. These professionals keep our mission moving forward with integrity and efficiency.
